title: Immutable Phase 4 behavior verification record (one BC-ID dual-platform execution pair)
description: Each record binds one Behavior Contract (BC-ID) to a paired execution on Android and HarmonyOS. The click/tap path on each side MAY differ; the acceptance criterion is that both runs reach the same observable_result with equivalent stored data, business computation, state transitions, persistence and side effects. The record-level verdict is generated by the deterministic comparator (compare_behavior.py); run records must never self-report PASS.

intent_passed.description: Written by the comparator after comparing both runs; a record author must not set this to true by hand.

verdict.description: Comparator-generated. PASS only when every applicable comparison (data/state/persistence/side-effect) passes; BLOCKED when either run did not complete. Run records must never self-report PASS.

persistence_snapshot.description: Stored/persisted values captured after the intent completed (preferences, database rows, files).

verdict.description: Execution status of this run only. PASS is forbidden here: the acceptance verdict exists solely at record level and is comparator-generated.

click_path.description: Optional trace of the interactions actually performed. Paths MAY differ between the two runs; they are evidence, not a comparison key.
